description: Opt-in: when a session starts or resumes, remove worktrees and branches whose PR already merged, and list what a merge left behind. Off until switched on in /config.

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_CLEAN_FINISHED_WORK" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/sisters/scripts/hygiene.py" --auto --hook ;; esac
